full_text: Intro Encompass® Automation Services From underwriting to the final disbursement call, we aim to automate lending processes to speed up the closing time with accuracy and minimize costs. Any part of the loan process that your employees carry out can now be automated with intelligent robots that are here to save you time and energy. With powerful features that can drive business success for lending institutions, our automation services will enhance your Encompass® experience. Full Name Email Contact No. Message Page URL Home » Encompass Automation Services Automation Solutions for Encompass® Intelligent process automation can simplify the time-consuming tasks that your Encompass® users spend. While the robots take charge of the mundane and repetitive processes, your team can focus on making critical evaluations. We help accelerate your mortgage decisions by providing refined and accurate data. Our solutions are a helping hand for underwriters, loan officers, closers, and others in between, enabling them to make more informed and better decisions. How We Automate Your Encompass® Instance Artificial Intelligence (AI) Automated document processing AI extracts and analyzes the important data from the provided documents to speed up the data entry process. Intelligent decision-making AI algorithms are extremely good at quick credit risk assessment. This means faster and better lending decisions. Document generation AI-powered systems can automatically generate essential documents, such as loan agreements, terms and conditions, promissory notes, and other legal paperwork. Chatbots and virtual assistants AI-powered chatbots can help customers by answering their queries and providing information about loan products and processes. Robotic Process Automation (RPA) WE MASTER EVERYTHING ENCOMPASS® Whether you’re venturing into Encompass® for the first time or seeking to refine your current configuration, count on us for exceptional solutions Our Hand-Crafted Plugins & Solutions Make Your Encompass® Instance Better EXPLORE ALL AN ABUNDANCE OF TECHNOLOGICAL DELIGHTS Discover the transformative power of these incredible tools that fit into your loan-originating system. Built with security and compliance in mind, our plugins adhere to industry standards to safeguard sensitive loan data. You can enjoy tremendous advantages by automating your loan origination system including increased efficiency, reduced processing time and improved borrower experience. What processes can it automate? Document indexing, information extraction, income calculations, prequalification process, underwriting, and much more can be automated. Is automation suitable for any organization? Automating Encompass can benefit companies of all sizes.
